description: Ministry of Finance - Import and Export Control Department - Promulgate regulations applicable to importation of goods by the Minister of Finance.
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, specifically amending import control requirements for certain goods. It contains detailed regulatory changes to import licensing requirements, including specific Harmonized System codes and product descriptions. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for import/export control.
